test_objective: Check that you can delete an attribute instance in temporal representation of an entity

test_cases.name: 017_01_01 Delete an attribute instance in temporal representation of an entity
test_cases.doc: Check that you can delete an attribute instance in temporal representation of an entity
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities/{temporal_entity_id}/attrs/speed/{instanceId}'
        method set to 'DELETE'
        Delete Attribute Instance from Temporal Entity: and
    Query Parameter: temporal_entity_id set to '${temporal_entity_representation_id}' and
    Query Parameter: attributeId set to 'speed' and
    Query Parameter: instanceId set to '${instanceId}' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/json' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
